title: Uniform global torsion bound after descent
statement: Let X be Noetherian, J ideal data, H and F coherent modules, and a:F→H. Let U_i be an open cover. Assume that for each i a positive power of J restricted to U_i annihilates both the restriction of kernel(a) and the restriction of cokernel(a). Then a single positive power of J annihilates kernel(a) and cokernel(a) globally.

proof.text: Coherence gives quasi-coherence of F and H, and the existing kernel and cokernel theorems give quasi-coherence of their kernel and cokernel. Choose local exponents; compactness supplies a finite subcover. Set s = max 1 (sup of its exponents). For each module and cover member, formalModuleQuotient_factor applied to the identity factors the s-power inclusion through the local t-power inclusion. The latter product is zero, so the former monic inclusion is zero and its source is zero. idealPowerProduct_restrict_isZero_iff transfers this to the restriction of the global product. hom_eq_zero_of_restrict applied to the identity on the finite subcover proves the global product zero. The empty finite subcover uses s=1.

theorem torsionControlled_algebraization_descent_bound
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H F : CoherentModules X) (a : F ⟶ H)
    (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤)
    (hlocal : ∀ i, ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap (U i).ι).toModulesι s).2
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj (kernel a.hom))) ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap (U i).ι).toModulesι s).2
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj (cokernel a.hom)))) :
      ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
          (kernel a.hom)) ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
          (cokernel a.hom))
